# Feature: potato ci exit codes

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-14 — issue #30 -->

## Intent
`potato ci` returns documented exit codes: 0 pass, 1 budget-fail, 2 CLI/usage, 3 infra, 4 inconclusive. Missing browser is 3, not 1. Noise or non-comparable compare is 4, not a fake pass. JSON and HTML report paths are printed in a machine-readable form.

## Preconditions
- Quick Scan (#18), report export (#29), compare (#28)
- Exit constants already live in `packages/cli/src/exit-codes.ts`

## Happy Path
- [ ] Documented exit codes 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 are implemented and each is tested at least once on `ci`
- [ ] Budget-fail (1) and infra-fail (3) are distinguishable
- [ ] CI writes JSON and HTML paths on stdout/stderr in a machine-readable form
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Missing browser → 3, not 1
- [ ] Collector incomplete / non-comparable baseline → 4, not 1
- [ ] Missing `--baseline` file → 2 after the run still emitted report paths

## Regression
- [ ] `potato run` still maps failed→3, inconclusive→4, budgetFail→1
- [ ] `potato compare` debug vs release stays 4
- [ ] `ci` is no longer a stub that always exits 0

## Assumptions
- UI copy and CLI messages are English
- `--baseline` is optional; without it, CI uses the run result only
- Report files go to `--out` or `.potato/reports/<runId>`
- No GitHub Marketplace Action; optional workflow not required for this slice

## Security Coverage
- B-03: local CLI only; no new network listeners
- P-02: error text has no stack traces or secrets
- F-03: no tokens in reports
- Out of scope: F-01, B-01, B-04, P-04 (no HTTPS product, no auth store, no SQL, no uploads)

## Implementation Notes
- `packages/cli/src/ci-cmd.ts` runs doctor → Quick Scan → `exportReport` → optional `--baseline` compare.
- Exit map: pass 0, budgetFail 1, usage/missing baseline file 2, doctor/scan fail 3, inconclusive/non-comparable 4.
- Stdout is one JSON `{exitCode,jsonPath,htmlPath,runId}`; stderr has `jsonPath`/`htmlPath` tab lines.
- Quick Scan now passes collection sample IDs as rule evidence so a p95 budget can actually fail (was observation-only).
- Tests in `packages/cli/src/run.test.ts` force 0/1/2/3/4 without Playwright.

## Composition Gate
- Verdict: CLEAR
- HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
- Event: one `potato ci` invocation → doctor → Quick Scan → report files → optional baseline compare → one process exit and one JSON summary.
- N-actors: 1 CI run → 1 exit code; report JSON+HTML are one pair, not N reports per metric.
- Invalid: missing browser exits 3 with null paths; missing baseline file exits 2 after paths are emitted; incomplete collector exits 4.
- Two consumers: stdout JSON and stderr tab lines describe the same paths; CLI tests lock 0/1/2/3/4.
